limits.en: Community access, job opportunities, standard discoverability and standard payouts. Client payment fees of $15 or $29 apply on payments above $500, and digital product fees are capped at 5% ($3-$29).

keyLimits.en: Client payment fees of $15 or $29 per payment above $500
Digital product fees capped at 5% (min $3, max $29)
Eliminates client payment fees and digital product fees; boosted visibility in Discover and job listings; faster payouts (2% fee) and crypto payouts (1% fee) remain optional paid add-ons

cautions.en: The Free plan is commission-free but not fee-free: client payment fees ($15 or $29 above $500) and digital product fees (up to 5%) apply until upgrading to Pro.

capabilities.en: Public portfolio and role-based freelancer profile (web developer, designer, etc.) for client discovery
Project posting and browsing, with tool-based filtering (Framer, Figma, Midjourney, etc.)
Custom invoicing and contract creation on the Pro plan

limitations.en: Free plan carries per-payment and per-product fees that Pro removes, so heavy users effectively need the paid tier
Invoicing and proposal workflow details are not documented on the public marketing pages

reason.en: Broader freelance marketplace with similar client discovery and project posting.
Competing freelance marketplace for commission-based service sales.

unknowns: Exact invoicing and proposal system mechanics not documented on public pages
No documented free trial for Pro plan
